answer: Each new agent must lock a copper bond, slashed if a clustering detector finds shared wallets, identical timing, or copied counterparty sets with another identity. Enrollment also opens a juniper log: a weekly Merkle root of work hashes and peers that must be extended in person and cannot be forked from a sibling. Voting weight and withdrawal rights vest only after that bond and log age into a relic window of several epochs, so a same-day alias cannot inherit influence or cash out. A farm of n puppets therefore pays n distinct aged bonds and n independently grown logs.
